e80abdd603ffbdcfc48615f824488f7c7402424f.subject: Improve external restart handling
e80abdd603ffbdcfc48615f824488f7c7402424f.blockedBy: Upstream's own wiring. The commit adds src/NzbDrone.Host/RestartableServiceLifetime.cs (249 lines) and simultaneously deletes the .UseWindowsService() call from Bootstrap.Start, but never registers the new lifetime: on Radarr develop today RestartableServiceLifetime appears in exactly one file - its own definition - and UseWindowsService appears in none. IsSystemdService is likewise declared on IRuntimeInfo and consumed nowhere. Take it once upstream lands the follow-up that actually installs the lifetime on the host builder.
e80abdd603ffbdcfc48615f824488f7c7402424f.reason: We want this: the in-process restart loop (Bootstrap.RunHostUntilShutdown + NzbDroneLogger.ResetAllTargets) replaces spawning a detached child process, which is the right shape under Docker/Podman/systemd restart policies, and the IsContainerized/IsPodman detection plus the LifecycleEventAttribute shutdown guard in EventAggregator are all portable to our tree as-is. Not skipped on the merits - it is half-landed upstream. Concretely, with UseWindowsService() gone the IHostLifetime is never a WindowsServiceLifetime, so RuntimeInfo.IsWindowsService is permanently false; that flag gates five real behaviours here (FileSystemLookupService network-drive lookup, DownloadedMovieImportService, MappedNetworkDriveValidator, LifecycleService service stop/restart, AppLifetime restart spawn), so picking it now would silently flip all of them on Windows service installs while the replacement lifetime sits dead in the tree. The commit is also three days old on develop and has not been through a release. Revisit at the follow-up.

cecb4052e49399d0407b22af7bd6555a57e4b6be.subject: Fixed: Improve caching of images without re-reading files from the disk
cecb4052e49399d0407b22af7bd6555a57e4b6be.reason: Replaces the disk-based lastWrite cache-buster with a hash of the remote URL to avoid re-reading files. We already solved this, and more bulk-efficiently: the batch fileInfos dictionary threaded through ConvertToLocal{Movie,Performer,Studio}Urls does one directory read for a whole page rather than a stat per cover, which is a deliberate choice for library sizes well past Sonarr's. Upstream's hash would also change cache-busting semantics for three entity types - a locally re-resized cover would no longer bust - so it is a regression here, not an improvement. Do not re-litigate.
